confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no July 2026 menus, rate cards or booking listings were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are the most reliable, while hostel and hotel rates vary with weekday, season and booking platform, so treat them as bounded estimates. Cocktail and wine anchors were set relative to the beer anchor because direct knowledge of bar pricing is weaker. Local-currency examples were converted at approximate general-knowledge rates, not live quotes.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. The basis is general knowledge of Malaysian heritage-tourism pricing, benchmarked broadly against mid-sized Southeast Asian tourist towns with similar street-food, hostel and hotel tiers.
